primary.title: ₹1 crore salary trap: Why high income does not equal financial freedom; CA identifies dangers of expensive lifestyle
primary.summary: CA Anil Sagayanathan highlights the fragility of high salaries and lifestyle inflation on LinkedIn. Even with ₹1 crore income, financial stress prevails due to rising expenses and peer pressure.
